prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: short wild meadow grass, mid green with cool blue-green shading, small grass blade clusters, a little clover, very few tiny pebbles. The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Generate a square seamless tileable top-down JRPG ground texture, edge-to-edge short wild meadow grass. Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art, crisp hand-placed uniformly sized square pixels, approximately 256 x 256 art pixels in the tile, with each art pixel visibly blocky and identical in size. Mid-green grassy base with cool blue-green shading, little scattered 3–10-pixel grass blade clusters and occasional tiny clover shapes, very few minuscule pebbles. Evenly distributed organic detail, no focal feature. Restrained earthy rich hue-shifted 4–6 shade ramps: saturated purple/red-leaning shadow greens, warmer yellow-green highlights. Clear purposeful pixel clusters, no checkerboard dithering, noise, blur, antialiasing, gradient, soft brush or photographic texture. Orthographic steep top-down old-school RPG map view. Clean neutral soft even overcast upper-left illumination, no cast shadows, nighttime effect, glow, light sources, or vignette. CRITICAL: mathematically seamless-looking wrap-around repeat, left edge matches right edge and top matches bottom with no seam; surface fills entire square with no borders, objects, characters or text.
